final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT p.SEX AS sex, AVG(e.`aCL IgG`) AS avg_igg, AVG(e.ANA) AS avg_ana FROM Examination AS e JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID GROUP BY p.SEX), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ana) AS overall_avg_ana FROM step1) SELECT s.sex, s.avg_igg, s.avg_ana, CAST(s.avg_ana AS REAL) / NULLIF(t.overall_avg_ana, 0) FROM step1 AS s CROSS JOIN step2 AS t WHERE t.overall_avg_ana IS NOT NULL
